basis.explanation: The two questions challenge the tension between choosing an action and shrinking from it. Reversing do and fear makes the listener confront that hesitation from both directions. This editorial reading takes it as a pointed challenge to indecision.

basis.existing_usage_example: An enthusiastic sales pitch makes a badly worn item sound like an exceptional bargain. A listener recalls the saying while looking past the pitch to inspect the item. This illustration is newly composed.
basis.literal_meaning: Whoever can talk persuasively can sell rotten shrimp.
basis.explanation: Persuasive speech can make even an undesirable thing seem worth buying. The rotten shrimp give the saying its sharp edge: selling skill and the quality of what is sold are two different things. The inspected article uses a close variant to illustrate the power of salesmanship.

basis.explanation: The opening makes talk costless; the next lines demonstrate how extravagantly someone can speak. The widening gap between scant ingredients and lavish results makes this an editorially clear image of empty boasting.
